what: Envato states it has a Market API enabling "all sorts of apps and tools, like browser extensions, WordPress plugins, web-based apps, widgets for your website, iOS apps, and much more" built by the community, with a collection of existing extensions and apps.
verbatim_snippet: "Our collection of extensions, apps and tools built using the Envato Market API by our community for our community. With the Envato Market API you can build all sorts of apps and tools, like browser extensions, WordPress plugins, web-based apps, widgets for your website, iOS apps, and much more. To learn more about our API, check out build.envato."
notes: Direct page fetch returned 403. Snippet from Google search index of this URL. Recovery method: Google search index. The page also references build.envato as the API documentation site.
